value.rationale: The exact mean threshold changes with wedge opening under one fixed heavy-tailed rate mechanism; half-plane criticality versus quadrant finite mean provides a direct geometric test. Arctangent full-time distributions and refresh cusps are observable diagnostics. The sampled-sensing theorem shows that a measurement convention alone can erase the finite mean obtained from continuous absorption, an experimentally and mathematically motivated distinction. These are substantive joint structural results rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
